information.description:
The tougher fighters among the Aldecaldos tend to lead smaller bands of riders into the city for work, or just hunt down their own contracts on the side. These Gunslingers are capable fighters, sport solid armaments, and usually have cybernetic reinforcements. They’re not as strong as some corp mercs, but they can hold their own.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Aldecaldos).

description.value: Car people, truckers, transportation afficionados, air-pirates, they are the sole carriers of product across the world, maintaining the transport and supply chains in the time of the Red.
Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
Standard Kevlar for your head. No armor penalty.
Light version of an Armorjack. No armor penalty.
A common CHOOH2-powered roadbike seen during the time of the Red.

Can be applied to all vehicles. Adds a tank of nitrous oxide to the vehicle. Allows you to use your Action to use an additional Move Action while driving.

You may install this upgrade multiple times, each upgrade adds an additional tank and each tank may be used once per day.

Can be applied to all vehicles. Adds two Hidden Holsters to the vehicle, and a large hidden compartment for smuggling purposes. These can be discovered with a DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object check.

Can be taken multiple times with the exception of Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters.
